summary.text: On July 14, 2026, Barr described potential broad economic benefits from AI alongside the possibility of worsening inequality, and urged consideration of policies to spread its gains. On April 4, 2025, he described potential improvements in financial services from generative AI while emphasizing risk-management responsibilities for banks, fintechs, and regulators. On April 17, 2025, he emphasized recognizing both generative AI's benefits and risks and focused on defending finance against deepfake-related risks.
